Product information "Hair Mask Hydration Rosemary/Ginger, 200 ml"
Looking for the missing piece of the puzzle in your hair routine? Our Moisturizing Hair Mask with a herbal-fresh scent of rosemary and ginger is the little upgrade to your hair care routine that you've been looking for. Whether you're already using our matching shampoo and conditioner or you simply need a rescue for your dry hair, the moisturizing mask is here to help!
This intensively nourishing hair mask is exactly what dry, brittle and dull hair needs. With a deeply moisturizing complex of vegetable glycerin, betaine, panthenol and black oat extract, your hair is pampered and supplied with plenty of moisture right down to the ends. Your hair will then shine with new radiance and be incredibly supple.
Application is very simple: after washing, massage the moisturizing hair mask generously into the lengths of your hair, leave in and then rinse thoroughly. Your hair will thank you for the extra care with improved combability and a silky-soft feel.
Try the matching hair care with our bestselling Rosmary/Ginger fragrance and discover shampoo, conditioner and refill sachets to match your new favorite hair mask.
